referee_caveats_inferred: Manual condensation selection and streamer grouping lack released catalogs and objective assignment rules.
The center estimate depends on six selected trajectories and clipping around a previous center; its uncertainty calculation is unspecified.
LTE, optical thinness and the adopted temperature range are not independently tested here; missing flux and excluded velocities complicate total-mass interpretation.
The printed mass equation includes a factor h defined as Planck’s constant; its intended normalization needs clarification before numerical reproduction.
The 120″ extent is described as a tip distance, an outflow size, and a diameter; the age convention requires clarification.
The introduction says nineteen streamers, while the abstract, labels and conclusions give eighteen.
The continuum text says ten sources, while the supplied table lists nine; the stated size criterion also needs reconciliation with point-source entries.
The bipolar-outflow orientation is described inconsistently across sections.
The shared-source and multiple-system disruption interpretation is qualitative and lacks identified stellar remnants.
